limitations: Current official no-postcode evidence excludes JM from postcode-data creation; it does not authorize a placeholder code or island-wide surface.
Kingston one- and two-digit sectors are address-place suffixes, not a complete national postcode assignment denominator.
Jamaica Post and UPU reviewed rights do not establish compatible postal dataset processing, derivation, redistribution or public serving.
The real JM API returned unsupported and no JM postal area was rendered.
In-app Browser navigation failed before page load; deterministic Playwright fallback did not yield a successful place-result-to-postal-area flow.
UPU PDFs rendered, but the local image-view helper failed with Windows error 206; byte, page, marker, dimensions and render hashes were verified.
